deviations.description: Case: phantom-only ("Commit one syntactically valid tracked *.sh, then mv it to a new path without staging. Assert build_errors == 0, status == "healthy", and phantom_paths == 1.")
deviations.reason: The plan's literal fixture (a single tracked file, moved) leaves zero real candidates after Phase 1's existence filter, which by Phase 1's own documented degenerate-case rule yields build_errors: null and status: "unknown" -- not build_errors == 0 / status == "healthy" as this case asserts. That exact shape (single candidate, all-phantom) is already the correct subject of Bar 6 ("all-phantom degenerate"). To make Bar 4's literal assertions (0/healthy) true while still proving a moved file contributes zero, the fixture adds one companion valid *.sh that stays in place (unmoved), so total_candidates remains nonzero after filtering. Verified against the negative control: the pre-fix script reports build_errors: 1 / status: critical for this fixture, confirming it is still a genuine regression lock.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — added a companion untouched valid *.sh so total_candidates stays nonzero post-filter, since the literal single-file fixture would hit Phase 1's all-phantom degenerate branch instead of healthy/0)*
